thread.title: Apple yanks Alex Jones’s Infowars app from App Store

author: Tripp Mickle
title: Apple yanks Alex Jones’s Infowars app from App Store
text:
Apple Inc. removed Alex Jones’s Infowars website from its App Store late Friday, eliminating one of the final digital platforms available to the right-wing provocateur.
The technology company took down five apps affiliated with Infowars for violating the company’s app-developer guidelines, an Apple AAPL, -0.81% spokeswoman said. Those guidelines preclude apps that deliver content that is “offensive, insensitive, upsetting...or in exceptionally poor taste.” That includes “mean-spirited references or commentary” about religion, race, sexual orientation and gender.
Infowars won’t be allowed to return to the App Store, the spokeswoman said. She declined to say what Infowars content violated Apple’s policies or when the company made the decision.
The removal came a day after Twitter Inc. TWTR, -1.04% permanently banned Infowars and its founder, Alex Jones, from its social-media platform. That followed previous content removals from Facebook Inc. FB, +0.31% and Alphabet Inc.’s GOOGL, -0.54% YouTube.
